Promise.CanonicalStatement: [The ONE sentence that captures the transformation promise] Example: "Restore youthful energy and mental clarity in 30 days without stimulants or side effects"

ForbiddenAlterations.Rule: Never change timeframe (30 days is locked)

Mechanism.Name: [The proprietary "how" - system/ingredient/method name]
Mechanism.CanonicalParagraph: [The ONE paragraph that explains the mechanism consistently] Example: "Unlike stimulants that burn out your adrenals, [MECHANISM_NAME] works by supporting your mitochondria—the cellular 'power plants' that produce 90% of your body's energy. Clinical research shows this natural compound helps restore mitochondrial function that declines with age, giving you sustained energy without the crash."

KeyPoints.Point: Targets root cause (mitochondrial decline), not symptoms

Pillar.CanonicalLanguage: "Multiple peer-reviewed studies show [COMPOUND] supports healthy mitochondrial function"
"Developed by Dr. [NAME], board-certified [SPECIALTY] with 20+ years researching cellular energy"
"Over 10,000 customers have experienced the benefits of [PRODUCT]"

Objection.Statement: "I've tried other energy supplements and they didn't work"

Rebuttal.CanonicalLanguage: "Most energy supplements rely on stimulants (caffeine, guarana) that mask the problem. [PRODUCT] is different—it addresses the root cause by supporting your mitochondria, the actual energy producers in your cells."

Objection.Statement: "How do I know this will work for me?"

Rebuttal.CanonicalLanguage: "We offer a 60-day money-back guarantee. If you don't experience noticeable improvement in energy and clarity, return it for a full refund. And you're not alone—over 10,000 customers have already experienced the benefits."

Objection.Statement: "Is it safe? Will there be side effects?"

Rebuttal.CanonicalLanguage: "[PRODUCT] contains naturally-sourced ingredients that have been studied in clinical trials. It's non-stimulant, so there's no jittery feeling or crash. As always, consult your doctor if you have specific health concerns."

CallToAction.CanonicalPhrasing: [The ONE CTA phrasing that's proven/tested] Example: "Click below to try [PRODUCT] risk-free today"

Urgency.IfUsed: [Only if real - limited inventory, promo end date]

CrossAssetAlignment.Rule: All assets (sales page, emails, ads) must use CanonicalStatement verbatim at least once
Mechanism CanonicalParagraph can be shortened but core logic cannot change
ProofPillars must appear in same order (Science → Testimonials → Authority → Results)
Objections must be addressed before final CTA

AudienceTemperature.Justification: [Why this classification? First-time buyers? Existing customers? Retargeting?]

Axis.StrategyNote: [How this message builds safety: guarantees, social proof, transparency, third-party validation] Example: "60-day guarantee + 10,000 customer testimonials + clinical research = multi-layered safety"
[How this message creates desire: vivid before/after, emotional pain points, future pacing] Example: "Paint frustration of low energy → contrast with vibrant vitality outcome"

[How this message builds logic: mechanism explanation (UMP/UMS), scientific backing, expert authority] Example: "Mitochondrial mechanism + peer-reviewed studies + credentialed formulator = logical proof"
Moderate status elevation (feel better, perform better) without overpromising
Soft urgency only (limited supply mentioned but not aggressive countdown)

Rule.Constraint: TOP score cannot exceed BOTTOM by 3+ points
Rule.Rationale: Promising elevation without safety foundation = manipulation
Pure emotion = hype; pure logic = boring

Rule.Constraint: FRONT cannot exceed BACK by 3+ points (urgency needs identity alignment)
Rule.Rationale: Pressure without belonging = manipulation red flag

Pattern.Name: Fake Countdown Timers
Pattern.Enforcement: No countdown unless tied to real deadline (webinar start, promo end, inventory limit)

Pattern.Name: Manufactured Scarcity
Pattern.Enforcement: Only claim "limited supply" if backend inventory tracking confirms

Pattern.Name: Fear-Mongering
Pattern.Enforcement: Problem awareness balanced with solution confidence (never catastrophize without hope)

Pattern.Name: Hidden Costs
Pattern.Enforcement: Full price transparency upfront (shipping, taxes, upsells disclosed)

Pattern.Name: Bait-and-Switch
Pattern.Enforcement: Promise in headline must match actual offer (no misleading hooks)

Question.Ask: THE PROMISE: Can I state transformation in ONE sentence?
Question.Answer: [Insert the canonical promise from Promise/CanonicalStatement above]

Question.Ask: THE PROOF: Can I explain WHY it works + show WHO it worked for?
Question.Answer: WHY: [Mechanism/CanonicalParagraph - mitochondrial support explanation] WHO: [ProofPillars P2/P4 - testimonials + 10,000 customers]

Question.Ask: THE TRUST: Have I made them feel SAFE (GABA ≥7/10)?
Question.Answer: BOTTOM axis target: 8.0/10 via guarantee (60-day) + social proof (10,000 customers) + clinical research + transparency

Question.Ask: THE DEAL: Is urgency genuine (not manufactured)?
Question.Answer: FRONT axis target: 6.0/10 (soft urgency only, limited supply if true) FRONT ≤ BACK+3 (6.0 vs 6.5 = balanced, no manipulation flag)
Question.PassCriteria: Urgency tied to real deadline/scarcity + FRONT ≤ BACK+3

Stage.name: PULLED_UP
Stage.CopyMapping: Opening: Establish safety (guarantee, transparency) → Then introduce elevation opportunity (restore youthful energy)

Stage.name: PRODDED_FORWARD
Stage.CopyMapping: Paint emotional frustration (low energy struggle) → Then provide logical mechanism (mitochondrial science)

Stage.name: VALUE_REINFORCED
Stage.CopyMapping: Layer proof: Science (RIGHT) → Testimonials (BOTTOM social proof) → Authority (RIGHT credibility) → Results (BOTTOM safety in numbers)

Stage.name: ENCOURAGED
Stage.CopyMapping: Paint aspirational identity (vibrant, energized version of yourself) + tribal belonging (join others who transformed)

Stage.name: SAFETY_ASSURED
Stage.CopyMapping: Address objections (safety concerns, skepticism from past failures, guarantee reinforcement)

Stage.name: ALIGNED
Stage.AxisActivation: BACK (this fits who I am, my values)
Stage.CopyMapping: Reinforce values alignment (natural not synthetic, science-backed not gimmicky, sustainable not crash-based)

Stage.name: MOVED_FORWARD
Stage.AxisActivation: FRONT (clear action, genuine urgency if applicable)
Stage.CopyMapping: Clear CTA (claim your supply) + soft urgency if genuine (limited inventory) + BACK still present (join the community)

PathCharacteristics.Item: SPIRAL not linear (BOTTOM touched multiple times: opening + social proof + objections)
3-DIMENSIONAL (moves through space, not just down the page)
GEOMETRIC (pyramidal faces create container forces pulling toward transformation)

FastTrackArchitecture.Principle: Every touchpoint accelerates movement forward (removes confusion, builds momentum)

AccelerationMechanisms.Mechanism: CLARITY: Simple promise (one sentence), clear mechanism (mitochondrial support), obvious CTA
SAFETY: Multi-layered GABA foundation removes fear of taking action
MOMENTUM: Each section builds velocity (empathy → hope → proof → confidence)
IDENTITY: Oxytocin alignment makes action feel natural ("this is for people like me")

AntiFunnelRules.Rule: Never filter people OUT ("this isn't for you if...") - instead show them IN ("this is for you because...")
Never create artificial hurdles (complex quiz, application) unless genuinely necessary for fit
Never make them "qualify" - make them feel WELCOMED

MinimumAxisScores.Threshold: Cold audience requires strong safety foundation

ValidationRequirements.BalanceViolationTolerance: Zero tolerance for balance violations (opposing pairs must harmonize within defined constraints)
ValidationRequirements.ManipulationTolerance: Zero tolerance (any prohibited pattern detected = automatic fail)
ValidationRequirements.RadicalSimplicityEnforcement: All 4 questions must PASS (single fail = message not ready)

IntegrationNotes.Note: The NeuroTargeting section enhances but does not replace the traditional MESSAGE_SPINE elements. Promise, Mechanism, ProofPillars, Objections, and CTA remain authoritative. Neuro-targeting provides the strategic layer that guides HOW these elements activate neurochemical responses.

Skills should reference BOTH traditional elements AND neuro-targeting: - Offer Architect: Uses neuro-targeting to define angle + UMP/UMS positioning - Sales Page Copywriter: Uses neuro-targeting to structure copy flow (transformation path) - Human Persuasion Editor: Uses neuro-targeting for final balance check - Neuro-Resonance Auditor: Validates against axis targets + balance rules - MMA: Enforces validation requirements defined here

Backward compatibility: MESSAGE_SPINE v2.0 instances (without NeuroTargeting) remain valid. MOD will infer basic neuro-requirements from audience + context if NeuroTargeting section omitted. However, v2.1+ with explicit neuro-targeting is STRONGLY RECOMMENDED for all new projects.
